## Initial analytics foundation

This milestone captures the existing pandas and optional Spark pipelines, synthetic fixture, session and SQL analytics, and initial automated checks.

- CSV validation, rejection auditing, and 30-minute inactivity sessions.
- pandas CSV/SQLite outputs and Spark Parquet outputs.
- Fixture verification and Spark/pandas boundary comparisons.

This is an engineering foundation using synthetic retail verification data. No trained model or healthcare outcomes are claimed.
